name: unit tests

on:
  push:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  typecheck:
    runs-on: ubuntu-26.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"
      - name: Install Ubuntu dependencies
        run: sudo apt update && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get -y install gettext appstream pkg-config libcairo2-dev gir1.2-gtk-3.0 libgirepository1.0-dev libicu-dev gir1.2-pango-1.0
      - name: Install Python dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip wheel setuptools
          pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
          pip install .[ai,face]
      - name: Run type checker
        run: mypy --install-types --non-interactive --ignore-missing-imports --exclude build .

  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-26.04
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.11", "3.15"]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - name: Free up disk space
        run: |
          sudo rm -rf /usr/share/dotnet
          sudo rm -rf /opt/ghc
          sudo rm -rf /usr/local/share/boost
          sudo rm -rf "$AGENT_TOOLSDIRECTORY"
          sudo apt-get clean
          df -h
      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      - name: Install Ubuntu dependencies
        run: sudo apt update && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get -y install gettext appstream pkg-config libcairo2-dev gir1.2-gtk-3.0 libgirepository1.0-dev libicu-dev tesseract-ocr gir1.2-pango-1.0 poppler-utils
      - name: Install Python dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip wheel setuptools
          pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
          pip install .[ai,face]
          pip list
      - name: Clean up package caches
        run: |
          sudo apt-get clean
          pip cache purge
          df -h
      - name: Check for single alembic head
        run: |
          HEAD_COUNT=$(alembic heads | wc -l)
          if [ "$HEAD_COUNT" -ne 1 ]; then
            echo "ERROR: Multiple alembic heads detected! Run 'alembic heads' to inspect."
            alembic heads
            exit 1
          fi
      - name: Test with pytest
        # loadfile keeps the tests of a module, and its fixtures, on one worker
        run: pytest -n auto --dist loadfile

  test-base-image:
    runs-on: ubuntu-26.04
    container: ghcr.io/gramps-project/gramps-web-base:latest
    services:
      # used by tests/test_shared_postgresql.py
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: gramps
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: gramps
          POSTGRES_DB: gramps
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 5s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - name: Install package
        run: pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements-dev.txt && pip install --no-cache-dir .[ai]
      - name: Test with pytest
        env:
          GRAMPSWEB_TEST_POSTGRES_URL: postgresql://gramps:gramps@postgres:5432/gramps
        # the base image ships the SharedPostgreSQL addon
        run: GRAMPSWEB_TEST_ADDONS_DIR=/root/gramps/gramps$GRAMPS_VERSION/plugins pytest -n auto --dist loadfile

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
